definitions.explanation: The relationship between time invested and results gained. Short for タイムパフォーマンス.

examples.japanese: タイパを{重視|じゅうし}して{倍速|ばいそく}で{動画|どうが}を{見|み}ます。
examples.english: I watch videos at double speed to prioritize time efficiency.

examples.japanese: この{方法|ほうほう}はタイパがいいです。
タイパを{考|かんが}えて{行動|こうどう}する{若者|わかもの}が{増|ふ}えています。
examples.english: More young people are acting with time efficiency in mind.

notes:
タイパ is an abbreviation of タイムパフォーマンス (time performance), meaning time efficiency.

ORIGIN:
Modeled after コスパ, from English "time performance." Gained popularity among younger generations in the 2020s.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- タイパがいい: time-efficient
- タイパが{悪|わる}い: time-inefficient
- タイパを{重視|じゅうし}する: to prioritize time efficiency

CULTURAL NOTE:
Reflects a cultural shift toward valuing efficiency. Young people often watch videos at {倍速|ばいそく} (double speed) or skip slow parts to save time.

RELATED:
- コスパ: cost-performance (value for money)
- {時短|じたん}: time-saving
